notes.title: 10 000 Wishlists – Thank You!
notes.content: [h3]We're incredibly excited to share that our game has officially passed [b]10 000 wishlists[/b] on Steam![/h3][h3]This means the world to our small team, and we’re beyond grateful for your support, interest, and excitement. Every wishlist helps us get one step closer to launch — and we can’t wait to show you more soon.[/h3][h3]Stay tuned, and thank you for being part of this journey![/h3]
